Subject: Aligning on ML/Infra deep-dive & availability (60–90 min)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap: AtlasHealth is focused on low-latency batch scoring for clinical triage and a phased rollout starting with a 10k requests/day baseline. Based on what we discussed, the next best step is a technical deep-dive with our ML + infra engineers to validate serving assumptions and production constraints.

Suggested scope for a 60–90 minute session (we can tighten if you prefer 60):
- 10 min: goals and success criteria for the pilot
- 20–25 min: model characteristics, expected sequence lengths, and pre/post-processing
- 20 min: serving architecture & latency/cold-start expectations (KV cache, batching)
- 15–20 min: throughput, RPS targets, scaling expectations, and monitoring
- 10 min: open Qs and immediate next steps

Please confirm who from your side should attend (ML engineer, infra lead, product). We can host the session next week — here are three windows (PT):
- Tue 2027-07-12 09:30–10:45
- Wed 2027-07-13 13:00–14:15
- Thu 2027-07-14 11:00–12:15

If none of those work, share two alternatives and we’ll accommodate. Also helpful if you can attach a small sample payload (10–20 rows) and rough QPS/RPS estimates ahead of time. I’ve attached a short prep checklist for your team.

Thanks — I’ll loop in Ben (infra) and Marissa (product) once we lock a slot.

—Kimberly Park
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
